title: Our Chenyu Vale Trek
description: Hezhe Post seems to be organizing an interesting event named "Our Chenyu Vale Trek"...

dialogs.text: Are you here to take part in the "Our Chenyu Vale Trek" scenic photography contest?
Scenic photography contest? What's that?
It's exactly as its name implies. It's a contest designed to promote the beautiful scenery of Chenyu Vale.

We previously surveyed the vale's residents to collect opinions regarding its most captivating scenic spots. Now, we're tasking contestants with going to and capturing images of said locations using their Kameras.
Lastly, we'll pick out a handful of exceptional ones to use as promotional examples, which will be exhibited on the street outside Hezhe Post. Well? How about it, you two?
I'm a practical person. What prizes are up for grabs?
Of course there is. If your works are chosen, there'll be a special surprise just for you.
Wow! A surprise!? We'd better give it our all, then!
Heh, we've still prepared a little reward for your time and effort even if your work isn't selected. We hope it'll be to your satisfaction.
Where do I start?
Have a look at this guide. These are the residents' recommended scenic spots of Chenyu Vale.
Huh? Why are some of the locations crossed out?
Heh, that's because those locations have been fully signed up for. We're hoping to provide a more comprehensive display of Chenyu Vale's beauty.
These four remaining locations are still available for registration. You can select one or more of them.
#Paimon gets it now... {NICKNAME}, how about we sign up for all of the remaining locations?
If our chance of winning the prize is one in four, then we'd be guaranteed to win if we take four photos! This way, the surprise will be ours for sure!
That's not how probability works.
Really? But isn't one quarter multiplied by four equal to one?
It is, but...
Hehe! What are we waiting for, then? Let's get going! That surprise is ours for the taking!
Nice math.
Great. There's no one better at photography than I am.
You look like you just can't wait to begin snapping some shots. Allow me to add that if your works are chosen, there'll be a special surprise just for you.
My dear friend, are you here to participate in the photography competition as well?
As a Fontainian photographer, one who's emerged from the Kamera's birthplace, let me offer you some advice: the purest essence of photography lies within the Kamera itself.

Hence, I'd like to introduce you to someone. Back in my hometown, the Kameras he makes are beloved without exception. They come at reasonable prices, too, and I know just how to get my hands on one...
Hey... Don't give me that uninterested look! I'll get you an extra discount!
Hey... Don't leave!
Heyo, friendo! You've been all over, I imagine you've had the pleasure of admiring quite a few sights in your time?
I wonder if the Chenyu Vale's spots for this contest will be able to top the ones you've experienced?

dialogs.text: Let's try calling the pelicans.
"Anng anng! Hree hree anng anng hree hree!"
"Hree hree! Hree hree anng anng hree hree!"
"Quack quack, Paimon, quack quack."
Hang on! Don't come any closer! Are you... are you good people?
Hey, we're the ones who saved you just now! Did you hit your head on something or...
Ah! You're right... I'm really sorry about that. My "Chenyu Vale Trek" has been nothing but dizzyingly bad luck... Thank... you...
So you're participating in the photography contest, too?
You are as well? What a coincidence! I'm just an ordinary tourist, though... So I couldn't do anything about those hilichurls.

I came across those louts on the road, and they captured and brought me back here without letting me get a word in lengthwise. Hilichurls don't also collect tolls, do they? Preposterous... Luckily, I ran into you guys.
Ah... Today was a tough day for you indeed.
Not just today! Yesterday was terrible as well. I bought a rather expensive Kamera from a Fontaine merchant, but it broke after only a few uses. When I went back to find him, he was gone...
What a shady guy... Be sure to keep an eye on your wallet while you're out and about!
Ah, sorry. Got a little sidetracked there. Since you're also taking part in the competition, you must be here to photograph Mt. Xuanlian, correct?
What say I share the best photography spot that I found around here with you as thanks? Here, I'll mark it on your map for you.
You can see it from here. In fact, it's right over there!
Eh? What about you then? Aren't you participating in the contest as well?
This area's rather dangerous, so it'd be best for me to switch things up. I remember the guide spoke of other locations... I think I should check out the Tea-Tasting Adeptus...
Yeah! That sounds good. Goodbye, you two! Hopefully, things start turning out well for me now!
Let's see... Where should I go next?

What's wrong? Are ours not good enough?
It's quite the opposite... I've seen some excellent submissions these past few days, but your works are refreshing all the same.
Let's take this shot of Qiaoying Village. The pelican adds a touch of liveliness to the tranquil village, contrasting stillness and movement... A one-of-a-kind approach, indeed.
If it were just up to me, your works would certainly be selected for use.
Wow! What a compliment! You're making Paimon blush a little.
Blush? You're not the one who took these photos.
Paimon was just feeling flattered on your behalf! Paimon knows all about your modesty.
Well, in any case, our selection process will be completed before tomorrow morning.
From eight in the morning until six at night, we will exhibit the selected works on the street outside Hezhe Post.
Thank you for participating in the "Our Chenyu Vale Trek" scenic photography contest. Don't forget to come back around tomorrow!
You bet! We're not gonna miss out on the final surprise!
I'm starting to feel a little embarrassed now too.

flow.stepDescription: Visit the exhibition of selected works outside Hezhe Post

dialogs.text: Ah, you've made it.
Have you seen the exhibited works? A total of eight works have been selected for this iteration of "Our Chenyu Vale Trek," and half of those are yours.
Congratulations!
Wow! That's awesome!
#See, {NICKNAME}? Paimon was right about getting four out of four! Paimon's math skills really are something!
It's four out of eight, actually.
Heh, the judges also showed great appreciation for your other two works, much like I said yesterday.
And so, please take this limited edition "Our Chenyu Vale Trek" commemorative photo album. It features all of the contest's selected works. You have earned it.
This was the surprise? Ooh, it looks amazing!
If it's alright with you, I also have some Mora for you. Please take it. I'd like to thank you again for participating, this time on a personal level.
This is my hometown, and you have forever captured the beauty of this place. These works will surely cause more people to fall in love with it.
Thank you.
Wow! Quite the mathematician, aren't we?
Uh-oh! That dupe from Inazuma is here as well. I'd better pretend I didn't notice him... Luckily, there's someone in between us, so he probably doesn't see me.
Darn it, why are these scenery photos so captivating? I don't wanna leave this place yet...
These photos were shot quite nicely. It's just a shame that the atmosphere around me seems rather off...
Maybe I should pick a different spot from which to appreciate them...
There he is! That shady Fontaine merchant! Has my luck really begun to turn around!?
I should just rush over and grab hold of him right now, but then I wouldn't be able to appreciate these charming photos of Chenyu Vale...
No... I would just suffer further loss that way. I'd be better off doing so after viewing them, especially for my selected work...
Is this pelican here yours, kid? Could we photograph it alongside Qiaoying Village?
Hree hree! Hree hree anng anng hree hree!
Eh? What are you saying?
It's pelican talk, which means "great, great!"
You speak pelican?
Only a little... because I noticed when they eat, they don't stop going "hree hree! Hree hree anng anng hree hree!"
I'm sure they're happily saying that it's "great, great"!
So I learned to call to them in that manner too. They come over as soon as they hear, probably because they think there's food.
If you wanna photograph one, then maybe you could try calling out to one yourself! It's too bad I gotta get home now, otherwise, I could teach you some more!
No worries, kiddo! We'll try it ourselves! Thanks, and get home safely!
#{NICKNAME}, let's give it a go over there! If we can attract a pelican, it'll increase our work's chances of success!
